Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM

DECLARE
 HDATE DATE;
BEGIN
 IF :System.TRIGGER_ITEM = :System.CURSOR_ITEM THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Value IS NOT NULL THEN
 HDATE := TO_DATE(:System.Cursor_Value);

 IF NOT HIJDATE.VALID_HIJ_DATE(HDATE) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 BELL;
 COMMIT;

 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) AND :SYSTEM.FORM_STATUS = 'QUERY' THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

 :title.user_name := :PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME;
 :title.SCREEN_NAME := :PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME;
 :title.SYSTEM_DATE := HIJDATE.Cur_Hij_Date;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
 IF NOT ID_NULL(FIND_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY')) THEN
 CLOSE_FORM('SUPPORT_ENTRY');
 END IF;

IF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 2 THEN
 RET := STR.DISPAlert('يجب ادخال بنود للتعهد او حذف التعهد','INFORMATION');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

ELSIF :GLOBAL.EXIT = 0 THEN
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);

 EXIT_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);

END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 if vis = 'TRUE' then
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible, property_false);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 else
 TMPLT.Populate_Functions ;
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-MOUSE-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 vis varchar2(200);
BEGIN

 vis := GET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', visible);

 IF vis = 'FALSE' THEN
 COPY(NAME_IN('SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM'), 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 ADJ_FUNS;
 GO_ITEM('DUMMY');
 END IF;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DOWN
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(-1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-UP
Trigger.TriggerText:
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 TMPLT.KEYB_UP_DOWN(1);
END IF;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
IF TMPLT.USING_KEYB = TRUE THEN
 Set_Item_Property('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT, VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE, 'STD_NORMAL_FUNCTION');
 Execute_Function('LSIDE.FN'||TMPLT.CURSOR_AT);
 GO_ITEM(NAME_IN('PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM'));
 COPY ('', 'PARAMETER.P_CURRENT_ITEM');
 TMPLT.USING_KEYB := FALSE;
 TMPLT.CURSOR_AT := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN IS NULL THEN

 SELECT COUNT(DCLTN_NBR) INTO V_COUNT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 IF V_COUNT > 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;
 DECLTN_LOV;

 ELSIF V_COUNT = 1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 1;
 SELECT DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT INTO :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT FROM DECLARATIONS
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR;

 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD;
 :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN := :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN;
 :global.Exec_QRy_Now := 1;

 END IF;
ELSE
 :GLOBAL.COUNTER := 0;
END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TYPE_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TIR_HEAD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TIR_HQ_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_TERMN_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستخدم', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'نوع البيان' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جهة الأوضاع الخاصه', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_MNFCT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PORT_CD,MNFCT_NBR' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_INSPECTOR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم المعاين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IMP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_GROUP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رمـز الجمـرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_FRIMEX_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FRGN_IMP_EXP_SEQ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_EXIT_PORT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز منفذ الخروج', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_DHLOWN_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في مالك بوليصة البريد السريع الدولي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في دولة الوصول النهائي', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BRKRAUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_BKM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رقم الرخصة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AG_AUTH_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'AGNT_ATHRZTN_NBR,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AGNT_IMPR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الشركة الوسيطة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_AEO_REAS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب اختيار المشغل الأقتصادى - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

 WHERE DCLTN_TYPE_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD
 AND DCLTN_STA_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD
 AND REC_STATUS = 1;




 :GLOBAL.DISPLAY_ALL :=1;

-- --
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;

/* CHK-DCLTN-B4-CLR */
BEGIN

/*
 IF CHK_DCLTN_B4_DISPLAY = 0 THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 */
 IF :SYSTEM.CURRENT_FORM = 'DCLN2295' THEN
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD NOT IN (1,2) THEN
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 IF :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.PT_LND') THEN
 DECLARE
 v_count NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM DCLTN_GATE_TRANS
 WHERE port_cd = :DCLTN_HDR.port_cd
 AND dcltn_isn = :DCLTN_HDR.dcltn_isn
 AND dgt_type = 7
 ;

 IF v_count > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('هذا البيان له فسح شاحنه جزئي','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 END IF;

END;

 ----------nihad khalil fagem 21/04/2009 for special department
 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
IF :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN
:SPCL_DEPT_FILLER1 := :DCLTN_HDR.SPCL_DEPT_ID;
ELSE
SELECT filler1 INTO :SPCL_DEPT_FILLER1 FROM TASKS
WHERE TASK_ID =NVL(:PARAMETER.P_TASK_ID,0);
END IF;
DECLARE
 V_CNT NUMBER;
 CURSOR DSDR IS
 SELECT DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(700);
 V_DEPT_NAME VARCHAR2(200);


BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_CNT FROM DCLTN_SPC_DEPT_RCV
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ISN
 AND WORK_FLAG = 0
 ;

 IF V_CNT > 0 THEN
 FOR I IN DSDR LOOP
 SELECT DEPT_NAME INTO V_DEPT_NAME FROM DCLTN_SPCL_DEPT_REFS
 WHERE SPCL_DEPT_ID = I.DSDR_SPCL_DEPT_ID
 AND REC_STATUS = 1
 ;

 v_spcl_dept_name := v_spcl_dept_name||','|| v_dept_name;

 END LOOP;
 V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME :=SUBSTR(V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME,2);


 IF :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD = 7 THEN
 :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC :=' معروض على '||V_SPCL_DEPT_NAME;
 END IF;

 ELSE

/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_HDR');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_HDR_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_ST_DCLTN_STA_DESC');
 IF (r_string IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 IF substr(r_string, 1,1) IN ('<','>','=') THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| r_string || ')';
 ELSIF substr(r_string, 1,1) ='#' THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC '|| substr(r_string,2) || ')';
 ELSIF instr(r_string, '%') <> 0 THEN
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC LIKE '''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 ELSE
 sub_where := add_and( sub_where ) || '(DCLTN_STA_DESC ='''|| replace(r_string,'''','''''') || ''')';
 END IF;
 END;
 END IF;
 IF (sub_where IS NOT NULL) THEN
 def_where := add_and( def_where ) || '((nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD) IN '||'(SELECT nvl(to_char(DCLTN_STA_CD), ''CG$NULL''), DCLTN_TYPE_CD '||'FROM DCLTN_STATUS WHERE '|| sub_where || '))';
 END IF;

 set_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE, def_where);

 EXCEPTION
 WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(33, 'Query criteria too complex - simplify and re-query'), 'E', 'OFG', 33);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_CNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :EXMTN_TYPE = 1 AND :PARAMETER.P_USER_ID NOT LIKE 'COC%' THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن اختيار هذا النوع من الاعفاء من المنفذ','ERROR');
 :EXMTN_TYPE := NULL;
 END IF;

IF :EXMTN_TYPE NOT IN (1,7,9,22) AND :FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن تطبيق نوع الإعفاء لصالح دولة أخرى غير السعودية','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
IF :EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 CHK_EXMTN_TYPE;
 -- FARZ
 IF :EXMTN_TYPE = 21 THEN
--&&& BY MOHAMED ABD EL_MONEM (EXT. : 4853) @ 23/03/2005 IN ORDER TO CORRECT ERRORS WHICH APPEAR AFTER NEW LIB.
/* ((DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> DCLTN.DSI_RLSD) OR
 (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> DCLTN.DSX_RLSD)) THEN*/
 IF ((DCLTN.IS_IMPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSI_RLSD')) OR
 (DCLTN.IS_EXPORT_DCLTN(:DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_TYPE_CD) = 1 AND :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_STA_CD <> CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DSX_RLSD'))) THEN
--&&& END
 MESSAGE('البيان غير مفسوح. لا يمكن تطبيق إعفاء الفرز إلا على بيان مفسوح');
 MESSAGE('البيان غير مفسوح. لا يمكن تطبيق إعفاء الفرز إلا على بيان مفسوح');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

 ELSE

 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_CNT
 FROM EXT_EXMTN_REQS
 WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT
 AND HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 AND XTRQ_TYPE = 5
 AND REQ_STA_CD IN (4,5)
 ;

 IF NVL(V_CNT, 0) = 0 THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد قرار فرز جاهز حاليا للاستخدام ببيان استيراد..راجع الاعفاءات');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد قرار فرز جاهز حاليا للاستخدام ببيان استيراد..راجع الاعفاءات');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF V_CNT=1 THEN
 SELECT REQ_ISN INTO :GLOBAL.CALL_EXT
 FROM EXT_EXMTN_REQS
 WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR
 AND DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_DT
 AND HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 AND XTRQ_TYPE = 5
 AND REQ_STA_CD IN (4,5)
 ;
 :GLOBAL.EXT_COUNT:=1;
 ELSIF V_CNT>1 THEN
 :GLOBAL.EXT_COUNT:=V_CNT;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

 SELECT TYPE_NAME
 INTO :ET_TYPE_NAME
 FROM EXMTN_TYPES
 WHERE TYPE_CD = :EXMTN_TYPE
 ;

 ADJ_TABS_DISP(:EXMTN_TYPE);
END IF;

IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE = 2
THEN :GLOBAL.DECREE_TYPE := 1;
ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IN (3,4)
THEN :GLOBAL.DECREE_TYPE := 2;
END IF;

-- BY SHERIFT -- 02-NOV-2004
IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE = 22 THEN
 CHK_EXMTN_A_FORMS;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;
/* CGFK$VALDIDATE_FK_OVF */
/* Check that foreign key value exists in referenced table */
BEGIN
 IF (name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_3(
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ET_REC_STATUS /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.ET_REC_STATUS. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ET_TYPE_NAME /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.ET_TYPE_NAME. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE ); /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE. */
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز نوع الإعفاء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

DECLARE
 ALERT_RET NUMBER;
 V_REQ_DUTY NUMBER;
BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE = 1 THEN
 IF ARAMCO_EXISTS = 1 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_NBR = 3643 AND TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR') = '14-02-1425' THEN
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT('هل أنت متأكد أن المستورد أو الشركة الوسيطة تابعة لشركة أرامكو السعودية ؟','USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 V_REQ_DUTY := 0.05 * :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY - V_REQ_DUTY;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE := (1 - V_REQ_DUTY/:DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY) * 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY * :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE / 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE * :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST / 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_NOTE := 'إعفاء لشركة أرامكو لتكون الرسوم بنسبة 5% فقط دون حد أدني لهذا البند';
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_NBR = 106 AND TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR') = '29-02-1427' THEN
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT('هل أنت متأكد أن المستورد أو الشركة الوسيطة تابعة لجنوب الربع الخالي المحدودة ؟','USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 V_REQ_DUTY := 0.05 * :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY - V_REQ_DUTY;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE := (1 - V_REQ_DUTY/:DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY) * 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY * :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE / 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE * :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST / 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_NOTE := 'إعفاء لشركة جنوب الربع الخالي المحدودة لتكون الرسوم بنسبة 5% فقط دون حد أدني لهذا البند';
 END IF;
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_NBR = 655 AND TO_CHAR(:DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR') = '23-12-1426' THEN
 ALERT_RET := STR.DISPALERT('هل أنت متأكد أن المستورد أو الشركة الوسيطة تابعة لشركة انيربسا للغاز المحدودة ؟','USR_CONFIRM');
 IF ALERT_RET = ALERT_BUTTON1 THEN
 V_REQ_DUTY := 0.05 * :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ORGNL_DUTY - V_REQ_DUTY;

 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY * :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE / 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE * :DCLTN_ITEMS.CIF_COST / 100;
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_NOTE := 'إعفاء لشركة انيربسا لتكون الرسوم بنسبة 5% فقط دون حد أدني لهذا البند';
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_DT',NEXT_NAVIGATION_ITEM,'DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY');
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 DPLMTC_APLCTN_COUNT NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR',NAVIGABLE) = 'FALSE' THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 IF :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR IS NULL THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 --------------------
 /*
 DM-313 Mohamed Shehata
 06-09-2021
 */
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO DPLMTC_APLCTN_COUNT
 FROM DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND aplctn_date = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 ;
 IF DPLMTC_APLCTN_COUNT = 0 THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد قرار إعفاء دبلوماسي بهذا الرقم');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد قرار إعفاء دبلوماسي بهذا الرقم');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSIF DPLMTC_APLCTN_COUNT = 1 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO DPLMTC_APLCTN_COUNT
 FROM dplmtc_aplctns_dtl
 WHERE (aplctn_seq,aplctn_year) IN
 (SELECT aplctn_seq,aplctn_year FROM dplmtc_aplctns
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR)
 AND DPLMTC_ITEM_STATUS = 1
 ;
 IF DPLMTC_APLCTN_COUNT = 0 THEN -- no items in a letter
 SELECT FORG_AFFRS_NBR,FORG_AFFRS_DT,APLCTN_EXPRY_DT,
 APLCTN_STATUS,OWNR_NAME,APLCTN_DATE
 INTO :FORG_AFFRS_NBR,:FORG_AFFRS_DT,:APLCTN_EXPRY_DT,
 :APLCTN_STATUS,:OWNR_NAME,:DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 FROM DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 ;
 IF CHK_VALID_DPLMTC_APLCTN THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR',NEXT_NAVIGATION_ITEM,'DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY');
 ELSE
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ELSE -- there is an item(s) found for this letter
 CALL_DPLMTC_LOV;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 CALL_DPLMTC_LOV;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 decrees_count NUMBER;
 decrees_count_HQ NUMBER;
BEGIN


IF :UB_DECREE_NBR IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO decrees_count
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES
 WHERE DECREE_TYPE = :GLOBAL.DECREE_TYPE
 AND DECREE_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_PORT_CD
 AND (HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR OR IMPR_EXIST_FLAG = 0)
 AND DECREE_NBR = :UB_DECREE_NBR
 ;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO decrees_count_HQ
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES_HQ
 WHERE DECREE_TYPE = :GLOBAL.DECREE_TYPE
 AND DECREE_PORT_CD = 99
 AND (HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR OR IMPR_EXIST_FLAG = 0)
 AND DECREE_NBR = :UB_DECREE_NBR
 ;
 IF decrees_count = 0 THEN
 IF decrees_count_HQ = 0 THEN -- maih 29-12-2012 for too_many_rows reason

 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد قرار بهذا الرقم لهذا المستورد','ERROR');
 :UB_DECREE_NBR := NULL;
 :ub_d_sub1 := NULL;
 :ub_d_sub2 := NULL;
 :UB_DECREE_dt := NULL;
 CALL_IMPR_EXMTN_DECREES_LOV;

 ELSIF decrees_count_HQ = 1 THEN

 SELECT DECREE_NBR,DECREE_SUB1,DECREE_SUB2,DECREE_DT
 INTO :UB_DECREE_NBR,:UB_D_SUB1,:UB_D_SUB2,:UB_DECREE_DT
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES_HQ
 WHERE DECREE_TYPE = :GLOBAL.DECREE_TYPE
 AND DECREE_PORT_CD = 99
 AND (HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR OR IMPR_EXIST_FLAG = 0)
 AND DECREE_NBR = :UB_DECREE_NBR
 --and DECREE_DT = :UB_DECREE_DT -- maih 07-10-2012 for too_many_rows reason
 ;
 CHK_VALID_DECREE;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_DECREE_NBR',NEXT_NAVIGATION_ITEM,'DCLTN_ITEMS.ub_d_sub1');

 ELSIF decrees_count_HQ > 1 THEN
 IF :UB_DECREE_dt IS NULL THEN
 CALL_IMPR_EXMTN_DECREES_LOV;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSIF decrees_count = 1 THEN
 SELECT DECREE_NBR,DECREE_SUB1,DECREE_SUB2,DECREE_DT
 INTO :UB_DECREE_NBR,:UB_D_SUB1,:UB_D_SUB2,:UB_DECREE_DT
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES
 WHERE DECREE_TYPE = :GLOBAL.DECREE_TYPE
 AND DECREE_PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_PORT_CD
 AND (HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR OR IMPR_EXIST_FLAG = 0)
 AND DECREE_NBR = :UB_DECREE_NBR
 --and DECREE_DT = :UB_DECREE_DT -- maih 07-10-2012 for too_many_rows reason
 ;

 CHK_VALID_DECREE;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_DECREE_NBR',NEXT_NAVIGATION_ITEM,'DCLTN_ITEMS.ub_d_sub1');

 ELSE
 IF :UB_DECREE_dt IS NULL THEN
 CALL_IMPR_EXMTN_DECREES_LOV;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;

--
/* IF :ub_decree_nbr IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 CHK_VALID_DECREE;
 END IF;*/

EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يوجد قرار بهذا الرقم لهذا المستورد','ERROR');
END;

/* CGFK$VALDIDATE_FK_OVF */
/* Check that foreign key value exists in referenced table */
BEGIN
IF ( name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL
 AND name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN') IS NOT NULL
 AND name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ') IS NOT NULL
 AND name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ') IS NOT NULL
 AND name_in('DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD') IS NOT NULL) THEN

 IF :EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD != 99 OR :GLOBAL.FILLER2 != 99 THEN
 BEGIN
 CGFK$CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_4(
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_MSR_UNIT /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_MSR_UNIT. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_STA_CD /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_STA_CD. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ARBC_DESC /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ARBC_DESC. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_QTY_BALC /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_QTY_BALC. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_HRMNZD_CODE /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_HRMNZD_CODE. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD.*/
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ. */
 ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD /* IN : Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD. */

 );
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'W', 'OFG', 0);
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
 END;

 ELSE
 DECLARE
 ISN_HQ NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 IF :GLOBAL.FILLER2 =99 THEN
 ISN_HQ := :GLOBAL.FILLER3;
 ELSE
 ISN_HQ := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN;
 END IF;

 CHK_DCLTN_ITEMS_DCLTN_4_HQ(
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_MSR_UNIT /* MOD: Value in Item :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_MSR_UNIT. */

 /*GO_ITEM('EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN');*/
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 ELSE

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 --END OF ADD

 THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT = :UB_INTL_MSR_UNIT THEN
 :GLOBAL.MATCH_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;

 :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY;

 END IF;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.MATCH_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY < :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY
 THEN :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY;

 END IF;
END IF;

--ADDED BY RSR IN '04-22-1425'--
---------------------------------
DECLARE
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 RET NUMBER ;


BEGIN
 IF :AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF :EXMTN_TYPE = 5 THEN

 SELECT COUNT (*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM AGRMNTS A , AGRMNT_MEMBERS AM
 WHERE A.AGRMNT_NO =:AGRMNT_NO2
 AND A.AGRMNT_TYPE = 4
 AND A.AGRMNT_NO = AM.AGRMNT_NO
 AND AM.MEMBER_ISN = :AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
 AND AM.MEMBER_STATUS <> 1 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 DISP_AGRMNT_DATA;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('رقم العضو ليس تابع لبيانات الإتفاقية', 'W', 'OFG', 0);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END ;
 -- END OF ADDED--
---------------------------------

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGAP$OLES_SEQUENCE_BEFORE */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF server_err = 1031 THEN
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40508 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الادخال ' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40509 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية التعديل' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40510 ) THEN
Des$Form_errors.PUSH('ليس لديك صلاحية الحذف' ,'E', 'OFG',0);
END IF;
END IF;
 END;
 END;
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_XRD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات نوع الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK3') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز الجمرك - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_SDP_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز جمرك الإستيراد للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RETITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر الحجز', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_RACT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'RACT_ACTION_NBR,PORT_CD,RACT_RET_BILL_NBR,RACT_AC' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_MU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس علي الفاتورة - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LSITMS_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى بيانات المبيعات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LFTITM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ فى االرابطة بين أصناف البيان و أصناف محضر المتروكات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_LACIT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'LACIT_ACTION_CD,LACIT_LFT_ITEM_NBR,PORT_CD,LACIT_' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'INS_TARIFF_CD,INS_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_INS_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_IMU_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز وحدة القياس الدولية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_ICA_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ICA_IDNT_ISN' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_GCC_EXM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'م.صنف الاعفاء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_FINAL_TRF_EXP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'FINAL_TARIFF_CD,FINAL_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_FINAL_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_TYP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز نوع الإعفاء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_EXMTN_DTL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء المستخدم - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DIR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات سبب التأمين - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DCLTNT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في نوع البيان الجمركي للصنف المعاد تصديره', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_DAPPL_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بيانات الإعفاء الدبلوماسي - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_CTRY_FK2') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('يجب اختيار بلد الشراء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_BRKR_TRF_XP_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'BRKR_TARIFF_CD,BRKR_TARIFF_ANAL_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_BRKR_TRFD_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في بند التعرفة الجمركية - إستخدم القائمة للإختيار', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_APPRV_USR_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في رمز المستعمل', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_AM_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم الاتفاقية,رقم العضو' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* FK - Child record found */
 IF (server_err = 2292) THEN
 IF (err_code = 40510) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'D_USD_VH_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','مواصفات السيارة المستعملة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DIL_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','Dcltn Item Letrs' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DIC_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','جدول يحتوي تأكيدات الأصناف' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DTSH_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'DCLTN_ITEMS','DCLTN_ITEM_SUB_HRMNZ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DSCDL_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'DCLTN_ITEMS','DEC_SEA_CRGO_DTL_LNK' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'RCN_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','فسح السلع المقيدة' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DIV_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','DCLTN_ITEM_VHCLS' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DSB_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','باتشات الغذاء و الدواء' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DS_DCLTN_IT_FK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(5, 'Cannot delete <p1> while dependent <p2> exists', 'الأصناف','إيقاف البيان بسبب التعليمات' ), 'E', 'OFG', 5);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (err_code = 40509) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (41105, 41106) ) THEN
 IF (err_code = 41105) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(35, 'Query of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الأصناف','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 35);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSIF (err_code = 41106) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(36, 'Insert of <p1> must be in context of <p2>', 'الأصناف','البيـــــــــــــان الجمركي' ), 'E', 'OFG', 36);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 V_NAME VARCHAR2(60);
BEGIN
 SELECT src.srce_name INTO V_NAME
 FROM dcltn_invoices dcl, srce_cmpys src
 WHERE (src.port_cd = dcl.port_cd)
 AND (src.srce_nbr = dcl.srce_nbr)
 AND (DCL.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (DCL.INV_ISN=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN) ;


 IF v_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.SRCE_COM:= V_NAME;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.SRCE_COM:= NULL;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.SRCE_COM:= NULL;

END;

BEGIN

 IF :EXMTN_TYPE = 2 AND :EXMTN_DECREE_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN

 SELECT NVL(FILLER3,0),NVL(FILLER2,0)
 INTO :GLOBAL.FILLER3,:GLOBAL.FILLER2
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS
 WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = :EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND APLCTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_ISN = :EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND ITEM_SEQ = :EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND ITEM_SUB_SEQ = :EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ
 ;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN

 NULL;
END;

BEGIN
 IF :EXMTN_TYPE = 1 THEN
 SELECT VAT_EXMTN_FLAG ,VAT_EXMTN_RSN INTO :VAT_EXMTN_FLAG,:VAT_EXMTN_RSN
 FROM DCLTN_VAT_EXMTN
 WHERE PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_cD
 AND ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN
 ;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
END;

/* CGFK$QRY_LOOKUP_DATA_MODIFIED */
/* Query lookup data for the foreign key(s) */

/* CGFK$RESET_BLOCK_WHERE_CLAUSE */
/* Resets block where clause */
BEGIN
 IF (CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_ITEMS_WHERE <> 'first_time') THEN
 set_block_property('DCLTN_ITEMS', DEFAULT_WHERE, CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_ITEMS_WHERE);
 CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_ITEMS_WHERE := 'first_time';
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_PORT_CD;

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 END IF;

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ITEM_ISN;
 END IF;

END;
/* CGFK$DEFAULT_WHERE */
/* Add restrictive query on FK items if value(s) entered in non-table items */
/* and/or if there are items which may contain nulls as valid values. Code to */
/* restrict the query is added to the default where clause of the block. */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 block_id Block := find_block('DCLTN_ITEMS');
 sub_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 def_where VARCHAR2(4000) := NULL;
 r_string VARCHAR2(512) := NULL;

 FUNCTION add_and(
 P_WHERE IN VARCHAR2
 ) RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 BEGIN
 IF (nvl( length(P_WHERE), 0) != 0) THEN
 RETURN( P_WHERE || ' AND ');
 ELSE
 RETURN( P_WHERE );
 END IF;
 END;

 BEGIN
 IF ( CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_ITEMS_WHERE = 'first_time') THEN
 CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_ITEMS_WHERE := get_block_property(block_id, DEFAULT_WHERE);
 END IF;
 def_where := CG$DCLN2230_PROD_GLOBALS.DCLTN_ITEMS_WHERE;

 sub_where := NULL;
 r_string := NAME_IN('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_DECREE_NBR');

DECLARE
V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL
 WHERE :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL
 AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD IN (SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = 'CANCEL_EXMTN')
 AND NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,0) NOT IN (SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = 'EXMTN_EXCEPTION')
 AND NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE,0) NOT IN (1,4,6)
 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EXMTN_DECREES WHERE EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_PORT_CD = NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD,0) AND EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_ISN = NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,0) AND EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_BNFCRY_CD = 2)
 ;

 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(' لا يمكن اضافة اعفاء لهذا الصنف','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-DELREC
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;
 PROP VARCHAR2(10);
 STAT VARCHAR2(10);
 PROP1 VARCHAR2(10);
 V_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN
 STAT := NAME_IN('SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS');
 PROP1 := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REMOVE',VISIBLE);
 PROP := GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SAVE',VISIBLE);
 IF PROP = 'FALSE' THEN
 NULL;
 ELSIF STAT !='NEW' AND PROP = 'TRUE' AND PROP1 = 'TRUE' THEN
 BEGIN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND :EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NOT NULL
 THEN

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 RET := STR.DispAlert('هل أنت متأكد من عملية الحذف','WARNING');
 IF RET = ALERT_BUTTON1
 THEN
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL
 WHERE :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL
 AND :DCLTN_ITEMS.CTRY_CD IN (SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = 'CANCEL_EXMTN')
 AND NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN , 0) NOT IN (SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE FROM CG_REF_CODES WHERE RV_DOMAIN = 'EXMTN_EXCEPTION')
 AND NVL(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE,0) not in (1,4,6)
 AND not exists ( select 1 from EXMTN_DECREES where EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_PORT_CD = nvl(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD,0) and EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_ISN = nvl(:DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN,0) and EXMTN_DECREES.DECREE_BNFCRY_CD = 2)
 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT '1' FROM CANCELLED_EXMTN_ITEMS CEI WHERE CEI.PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD AND CEI.ITEM_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN )
 ;
 IF V_COUNT > 0 THEN
 INSERT INTO CANCELLED_EXMTN_ITEMS (PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,INSERT_DT)
 VALUES (:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD ,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ISN ,SYSDATE)
 ;
 END IF;

 INTRFACE.MAKE_BLOCK_FULL_OPERATION('DCLTN_ITEMS',FALSE,TRUE,FALSE);
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE := NULL;
 CLEAR_EXMTN_FIELDS;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('AGRMNT_NO2',ITEM_IS_VALID,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXMTN_TYPE2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 GO_ITEM('DCLTN_NBR');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXMTN_TYPE',REQUIRED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 --INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('EXMTN_TYPE',TRUE);

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-BLOCK-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
BEGIN
 SELECT HQ_IMPR_NBR
 INTO :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR
 FROM DECLARATIONS DCLTN, IMPORTERS IMPR
 WHERE DCLTN.DCLTN_ISN = :PARAMETER.P_DCLTN_ISN
 AND IMPR.IMPR_NBR = DCLTN.IMPR_NBR
 AND IMPR.PORT_CD= DCLTN.PORT_CD
 ;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FINAL_TARIFF_CD2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DECREES_LOV_BUT',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('REQ_ITMS_LOV_BUT',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXT_PORT_LOV_BUT',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 EXCEPTION

END;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-NEW-RECORD-INSTANCE
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
RET BOOLEAN;

BEGIN
/*DEVLOPED BY :KAMEL ELSAYED
 DATE :28/05/2007
 MODIFICATIONS :MAKE FILED DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY UPDATED IF ENABLED TRUE
*/
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY',ENABLED)='TRUE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY',UPDATE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 :GLOBAL.INDUSTRY_TYPE := NULL;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXMTN_TYPE2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 INTRFACE.MAKE_BLOCK_FULL_OPERATION('DCLTN_ITEMS',FALSE,TRUE,FALSE);


IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.AGRMNT_NO2 IS NOT NULL THEN
 DISP_AGRMNT_DATA;
END IF;


IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL
THEN -- THERE ARE Related Exemptions Data
 CHK_EXMTN_TYPE;
 -- Exemption Decree (Industrial or Governmental) -----
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 DISP_DECREE_DATA;
 Set_Record_Property( 1, 'DCLTN_ITEMS', STATUS, QUERY_STATUS);
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 DISP_DECREE_ITEM_DATA;
 END IF;

---------------------------------------------------------
----- Diplomatic Exemption ------------------------------
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 DISP_DPLMTC_DATA;

---------------------------------------------------------
----- Agreement Exemption ------------------------------
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IN (5,7,9,10) AND :AGRMNT_NO2 IS NOT NULL
 THEN
 --DISP_AGRMNT_DATA;
NULL;
---------------------------------------------------------
----- Transfered Exemption From Another Port ------------
 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN IS NOT NULL
 THEN

 SELECT SDP.PORT_NAME,RQS.DECREE_PORT_CD
 INTO :UB_EXT_DECREE_PORT_NM,:UB_EXT_DECREE_PORT_CD
 FROM SD_PORTS SDP,EXT_EXMTN_REQS RQS
 WHERE RQS.REQ_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN
 AND RQS.ISSUE_PORT_CD = :EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD
 AND SDP.PORT_CD = RQS.DECREE_PORT_CD;

 RET := DISP_EXT_REQ_DATA;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL
 THEN RET := DISP_EXT_REQ_ITEM_DATA;
 END IF;
 INTRFACE.MAKE_FIELD_ENTRABLE('EXMTD_QTY',FALSE);


---------------------------------------------------------
---------------------------------------------------------
 END IF;

END IF;

IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND :EXMTN_APRVL_DT IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- APPROVED EXEMPTION EXIST
 INTRFACE.MAKE_BLOCK_QUERY_ONLY('DCLTN_ITEMS');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXMTN_TYPE2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.CURSOR_RECORD,'DCLTN_ITEMS',STATUS,QUERY_STATUS);
ELSE
 INTRFACE.MAKE_BLOCK_FULL_OPERATION('DCLTN_ITEMS',FALSE,TRUE,FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXMTN_TYPE2',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_REPORT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE PRINT_REPORT(FN In VARCHAR2, PL_ID PARAMLIST, V_REP_FRM_FLG NUMBER, V_REP_PRNT_FLG NUMBER) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;


 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(500);
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
/*
 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;
*/
 BEGIN
/* IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD LIKE FN THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE = 6
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);

ProgramUnit.Name: EXECUTE_FUNCTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 PROCEDURE Execute_Function(FN In VARCHAR2) IS
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 FOUND_CD BOOLEAN := FALSE;
 ROW_COUNT NUMBER := 1;
 CD_TITLE VARCHAR2(200);
 RET NUMBER;
 V_MSG VARCHAR2(2000);

 V_MOD_ID NUMBER;
 V_PATH VARCHAR2(200);
 pl_id ParamList;
 V_CALLED_FORM VARCHAR2(200);
 V_MOD_NAME VARCHAR2(200);
 V_SEQ_NO NUMBER;
 V_SYS_TYPE NUMBER;
 V_FILE_NAME VARCHAR2(200);

 cursor c_modudle_parameter(p_mid NUMBER)
 is select VAR_NAME ,VAR_VALUE
 from sc_port_setting
 where PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD -- NALSALEH CENTRALIZED PROJECT
 AND sysobj_id = p_mid;

 BEGIN
 IF FN IS NOT NULL THEN
 SET_VIEW_PROPERTY('LSIDE', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 CD_TITLE := NAME_IN(FN);

 WHILE ROW_COUNT <= TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS_COUNT AND NOT FOUND_CD LOOP
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).TITLE LIKE CD_TITLE AND TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).ACT = 1 THEN
 FOUND_CD := TRUE;
 ELSE
 ROW_COUNT := ROW_COUNT + 1;
 END IF;

 END LOOP;

 IF FOUND_CD THEN
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID IS NOT NULL THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT SYS_OS_FILE_NAME, SYS_ANAME, SYS_TYPE, SEQ_NO
 INTO V_FILE_NAME, V_MOD_NAME, V_SYS_TYPE, V_SEQ_NO
 FROM sc_system_objects
 WHERE SYS_TYPE IN (5,6)
 AND SYS_STATUS = 1
 AND SYSOBJ_ID = TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END;

 IF V_FILE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 ret := Str.Dispalert('Error creating parameter list TMPLT_MOD_CALL IN TEMPLATE ', 'SYSTEM_ERROR');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_USER_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_USER_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_WS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_WS_ID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_PORT_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_GROUP_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_GROUP_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_USER_TYPE', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_USER_TYPE);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id ,'P_JOB_ID', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'P_CLASS_CD', TEXT_PARAMETER, :PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_MOD_NAME);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_PORT_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_SHPG_AGNT_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BRKR_NBR' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_CD' ,TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_CD);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_BANK_BRNCH_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_BANK_BRNCH_CD);
 for i in c_modudle_parameter(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID)
 loop
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id ,i.VAR_NAME,TEXT_PARAMETER,i.VAR_VALUE);
 end loop;

 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('TMPLT_MOD_CALL');
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PATH;
 IF SUBSTR(V_CALLED_FORM, LENGTH(V_CALLED_FORM), 1) <> '\' THEN
 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||'\';
 END IF;


 V_CALLED_FORM := V_CALLED_FORM||V_FILE_NAME;
 IF V_SYS_TYPE = 5 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSE
 DEFAULT_VALUE('0', 'GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_SYS_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,V_SEQ_NO);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:GLOBAL.SYSTEM_OBJ ||'-'||V_SEQ_NO);
 IF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).FORM_FLAG = 1 THEN
 CALL_FORM(V_CALLED_FORM,
 no_hide,
 no_replace,
 no_query_only,
 pl_id);
 ELSIF TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).PRNT_FLAG = 1 THEN
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');

 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,BATCH,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 IF ADJ_PRN.ADJ_REPORT_PRINTER(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).MID, V_MSG) = TRUE THEN
 REP.Run_Product(REPORTS,V_CALLED_FORM,SYNCHRONOUS,RUNTIME,FILESYSTEM,pl_id,NULL);
 ELSIF V_MSG IS NOT NULL THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG, 'ERROR');
 ELSE
 STR.DISPALERT('لا يمكن ضبط الطابعة للتقرير', 'ERROR');
 END IF;

 END IF;
 END IF;

 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 END IF;
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||'TMPLT_MOD_CALL'||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('الشاشة المطلوبة غير معرفة داخل نظام الأمن او انها غير فعالة' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 ELSE
 EXEC_FUNS(TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD);
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := TMPLT.FUN_ITEMS(ROW_COUNT).CD;
 EXEC_FUNS('MOD_CALL_BACK');
 :PARAMETER.P_CTRL_LAST_EXEC_CD := NULL;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 RET := STR.DISPALERT('خطأ داخلي في أكواد الوظائف - إتصل بالمساندة الفنية' ,'ERROR');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END Execute_Function;

/* CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE */
PROCEDURE CG$WHEN_NEW_FORM_INSTANCE IS
BEGIN
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
/* Read the values for dynamic lists from the CG_REF_CODES table */
BEGIN
 CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 CGTE$OTHER_EXCEPTIONS;
END;

/* CGBS$STARTUP */
/* Perform start-up processing for Block Synchronization */
BEGIN
 /* Set the defaults for the globals */
 :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 /* Set the relations to the default query mode */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the query mode items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( :GLOBAL.CG$QUERY_MODE );
END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_LOW_VALUE, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DCLTN_PMT_METHOD'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_HDR.PMT_METHOD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''VAT_EXMTN_FLAG'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.VAT_EXMTN_FLAG', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''VAT_EXMTN_RSN'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.VAT_EXMTN_RSN', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''DECREE_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_TYPE', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||
 'WHERE RV_DOMAIN = ''EXMTN_ITEM_TYPE'' '||
 'ORDER BY 2');
 temp := populate_group(rg_id);
 populate_list('DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD', rg_id);
 delete_group(rg_id);

 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_STATUS_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTNT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل موجود بالفعل - أعد إدخال بيانات جديدة', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'SDP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'IMP_BUSID_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('هذا السجل مدخل سابقاً - أعد ادخال البيانات', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DCLTN_IT_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'PORT_CD,ITEM_ISN,FINAL_TARIFF_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'DAP_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم الخطاب,تاريخ الخطاب' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'BFRM_UK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('لا يمكن تكرار رقم الاستمارة على نفس قرار الاعفاء', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'HT_PK') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(Des$Form_errors.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'البند المنسق' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'VALID_DATE_NUMBER') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('خطأ في عملية ترقيم البيان الجمركي - يجب وجود رقم وتاريخ في نفس الوقت', 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$Form_errors.RAISE_FAILURE;
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$TOGGLE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$TOGGLE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$TOGGLE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Toggle query mode between BSMON and BSMOFF, set all query mode items, */
/* display query mode message, set the relations and ensure that the */
/* canvas is coordinated. */
BEGIN
 /* Toggle the mode */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE != 'A') THEN
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 ELSE
 P_QUERY_MODE := 'A';
 END IF;
 /* Set all the items */
 CGBS$SET_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Display query mode messages */
 CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* Set the relations */
 CGBS$.SET_RELATIONS( P_QUERY_MODE );
 /* If the query mode is AutoQuery, coordinate outstanding blocks */
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 CGBS$.COORD_VISIBLE_BLKS( :SYSTEM.CURSOR_BLOCK );
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE */
PROCEDURE CGBS$MESSAGE_QUERY_MODE(
 P_QUERY_MODE IN VARCHAR2) IS /* Query Mode */
/* Send a message to the status line indicating the current query mode */
BEGIN
 IF (P_QUERY_MODE = 'A') THEN
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode on', 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 ELSE
 Des$Form_errors.PUSH('Auto-query mode off', 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPD_DPLMTC_APLCTNS_DTL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE upd_dplmtc_aplctns_dtl(p_dml IN VARCHAR2) IS
/*
DM-313 Mohamed Shehata
06-09-2021
*/
BEGIN
 IF p_dml IN ('i','u') THEN
 IF :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE dplmtc_aplctns_dtl
 SET DPLMTC_ITEM_STATUS = 2
 WHERE (APLCTN_SEQ,APLCTN_YEAR) IN
 (
 SELECT APLCTN_SEQ,APLCTN_YEAR
 FROM dplmtc_aplctns
 WHERE aplctn_nbr = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND aplctn_date = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 )
 AND DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ
 AND NVL(DPLMTC_ITEM_STATUS,0) <> 2
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 --------
 IF p_dml = ('d') THEN
 IF :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE IS NOT NULL AND :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ IS NOT NULL THEN
 UPDATE dplmtc_aplctns_dtl
 SET DPLMTC_ITEM_STATUS = 1
 WHERE (APLCTN_SEQ,APLCTN_YEAR) IN
 (
 SELECT APLCTN_SEQ,APLCTN_YEAR
 FROM dplmtc_aplctns
 WHERE aplctn_nbr = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND aplctn_date = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 )
 AND DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ
 AND NVL(DPLMTC_ITEM_STATUS,0) <> 1
 ;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_EXMTN_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION SET_EXMTN_DATA RETURN NUMBER IS
 V_MSG_TXT VARCHAR2(2000);
 LIN DUTY.T_DCLTN_ITEMS_EXMTN;

 V_EXMTD_CIF NUMBER;
 V_EXMTD_DUTY NUMBER;
 V_EXMTN_RATE NUMBER;
BEGIN
 LIN.PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD;
 LIN.INV_MSR_UNIT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT;
 LIN.INV_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;
 LIN.INTL_MSR_UNIT := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_MSR_UNIT;
 LIN.INTL_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
 LIN.CIF_COST := :CIF_COST;
 LIN.ORGNL_DUTY := :ORGNL_DUTY;
 LIN.EXMTN_TYPE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_TYPE;
 LIN.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD;
 LIN.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN;
 LIN.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ;
 LIN.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ;
 LIN.EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD;
 LIN.EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN;
 LIN.EXT_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ;
 LIN.EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_QTY;
 LIN.EXMTN_RATE := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE;
 LIN.EXMTD_DUTY := :EXMTD_DUTY;
 LIN.EXMTD_CIF := :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF;
/*
 IF DUTY.SET_EXMTN_DATA(LIN, :CIF_COST, :ORGNL_DUTY, :EXMTD_CIF, :EXMTD_DUTY, :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE, V_MSG_TXT) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 END IF;

 */ /**/

 IF DUTY.SET_EXMTN_DATA(LIN, :CIF_COST, :ORGNL_DUTY, V_EXMTD_CIF, V_EXMTD_DUTY, V_EXMTN_RATE, V_MSG_TXT ) = 0 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT(V_MSG_TXT, 'ERROR');
 RETURN 0;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_RATE := V_EXMTN_RATE;
 IF NVL(V_EXMTD_DUTY,0) = 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY := NULL;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_DUTY := V_EXMTD_DUTY;
 END IF;

 IF NVL(V_EXMTD_CIF,0)= 0 THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF := NULL;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTD_CIF := V_EXMTD_CIF;
 END IF;
 END IF;


 IF :EXMTN_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
/*
 IF :EXMTD_CIF <> :CIF_COST THEN
 :EXMTD_CIF := SET_HALALA_OLD(:EXMTD_CIF);
 :EXMTD_DUTY := SET_HALALA_OLD(:EXMTD_DUTY);
 END IF;
*/

 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_OLD') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_EXM_OLD');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_DCREE') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_EXM_DCREE');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_DRAW') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_EXM_DRAW');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_TEMP') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_EXM_TEMP');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_DISAGREE') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_EXM_DISAGREE');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE = CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_OTH') THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_INS_EXM_OTH');

 ELSIF :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE IN (CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DEF'), CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_DOC_INS')) THEN
 IF :EXMTD_DUTY = :ORGNL_DUTY THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EXM_ALL');
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DUTY_TYPE := CONSTS.GET_CONST_VAL('DCLTN.DT_EXM_PART');
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN 1;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_DPLMTC_LTR_STAT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
--FUNCTION CLOSE_DPLMTC_LTR RETURN BOOLEAN IS
FUNCTION SET_DPLMTC_LTR_STAT(NEW_STATUS NUMBER) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 V_TOTAL NUMBER;
 V_USED NUMBER;
 v_dtl_accept_recs NUMBER;
 v_dtl_recs NUMBER;
BEGIN
 SELECT TOT_EXMTN_ITEMS_COUNT,USED_ITEMS_COUNT
 INTO V_TOTAL , V_USED
 FROM DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 --AND HI_HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR -- BY RAMY upon hesham 24-10-2005
 ;
 V_USED := V_USED + 1;
 ------dm-313-----
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO v_dtl_recs
 FROM DPLMTC_APLCTNS_DTL
 WHERE (aplctn_seq,aplctn_year)
 IN
 (
 SELECT aplctn_seq,aplctn_year
 FROM DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 )
 AND dplmtc_item_status IN (1,2) -- مقبول - مستخدم
 ;
 ----
 IF v_dtl_recs >= 1 THEN -- MOFA
 V_TOTAL := v_dtl_recs;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_USED
 FROM dplmtc_aplctns_dtl
 WHERE (aplctn_seq,aplctn_year)
 IN
 (
 SELECT aplctn_seq,aplctn_year
 FROM dplmtc_aplctns
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 )
 AND dplmtc_item_status = 2
 ;
 END IF;-- MOFA
 -------------
 IF NEW_STATUS = 5 THEN
 IF V_USED = V_TOTAL THEN
 UPDATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 SET APLCTN_STATUS = NEW_STATUS,
 USED_ITEMS_COUNT = V_USED
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 --AND HI_HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR -- BY RAMY upon hesham 24-10-2005
 ;
 --------- DM313 -----------
 IF v_dtl_recs >= 1 THEN -- SEND NOTIFICATION TO MOFA
 DECLARE
 p_APLCTN_DATE VARCHAR2(100);
 p_APLCTN_NBR VARCHAR2(100);
 p_APLCTN_SATUS NUMBER(1);
 p_status_out NUMBER;
 p_ResponseStatus VARCHAR2(100);
 p_ResponseCode NUMBER;
 p_SeverityLevel VARCHAR2(100);
 p_result NUMBER;
 p_result_msg VARCHAR2(200);
 BEGIN
 p_APLCTN_DATE := TO_CHAR(:DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd');--'2022-10-10T00:00:00';
 p_APLCTN_NBR := :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR;--'DM21101';
 p_APLCTN_SATUS := '5';
 -----------------
 PRTL_EXMTN.call_web_srv_letter(p_APLCTN_DATE,p_APLCTN_NBR,p_APLCTN_SATUS,
 p_status_out,p_ResponseStatus,p_ResponseCode,p_SeverityLevel,p_result,p_result_msg);
 /*
 if p_ResponseStatus = 'Success' then
 str.dispalert('تم ارسال اشعار - استخدام الخطاب - بنجاح لوزارة الخارجية','INFORMATION');
 else
 str.dispalert('فشل فى الارسال لوزارة الخارجية'||' Erorr_code: '||p_ResponseCode,'INFORMATION');
 --P_SEND_FLAG := 0;
 forms_ddl('rollback');
 end if;
 */
 end;
 end if; -- MOFA
 ---------------------------
 ELSE
 UPDATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 SET USED_ITEMS_COUNT = V_USED
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 --AND HI_HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR -- BY RAMY upon hesham 24-10-2005
 ;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NEW_STATUS = 4 THEN
 V_USED := V_USED - 1 ;
 IF V_USED < V_TOTAL THEN
 UPDATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 SET APLCTN_STATUS = NEW_STATUS,
 USED_ITEMS_COUNT = V_USED
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 --AND HI_HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR -- BY RAMY upon hesham 24-10-2005
 ;
 END IF;
 ELSIF NEW_STATUS in (2,6) THEN -- dm-313
 UPDATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 SET APLCTN_STATUS = NEW_STATUS
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 --AND HI_HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR -- BY RAMY upon hesham 24-10-2005
 ;
 update dplmtc_aplctns_dtl
 set dplmtc_item_status = 1
 where DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ = :DPLMTC_ITEM_SEQ
 and (aplctn_seq,aplctn_year)
 in
 (
 select h.aplctn_seq,h.aplctn_year
 from dplmtc_aplctns h
 where h.aplctn_nbr = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 and h.aplctn_date = :dcltn_items.DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 )
 ;

 END IF;

 /*
 UPDATE DPLMTC_APLCTNS
 SET APLCTN_STATUS = NEW_STATUS
 WHERE APLCTN_NBR = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR
 AND APLCTN_DATE = :DPLMTC_EXMTN_DATE
 AND IMP_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_HDR.PORT_CD
 AND IMP_IMPR_NBR = :DCLTN_HDR.IMPR_NBR
 --AND HI_HQ_IMPR_NBR = :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR;-- BY RAMY upon hesham 24-10-2005
 */
 RETURN(TRUE);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RETURN(FALSE);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ENB_TAB_NAV
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE ENB_TAB_NAV(TAB_NAME VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_1' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_NBR',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_SUB_NBR',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.SYS_EXMTN_DT',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_2' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.AGRMNT_NO2',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_3' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.DPLMTC_EXMTN_NBR',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_4' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_DECREE_NBR',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_D_SUB1',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_D_SUB2',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_DECREE_DT',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_5' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_6' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.UB_EXT_DECREE_PORT_CD',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXT_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 --BY SHERIFT 01-NOV-2004
 ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_7' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.L_AFRM_EXM_REF_NBR',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);

/* ELSIF TAB_NAME = 'CG$TAB_PAGE_7' THEN

 END IF;
END;

PROCEDURE DISP_SRC_COMP_DATA IS
V_NAME VARCHAR2(60);
BEGIN
SELECT src.srce_name INTO V_NAME
 FROM dcltn_invoices dcl, srce_cmpys src
 WHERE (src.port_cd = dcl.port_cd)
 AND (src.srce_nbr = dcl.srce_nbr)
 AND (DCL.PORT_CD=:DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD)
 AND (DCL.INV_ISN=:DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_ISN) ;


 IF v_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.SRCE_COM:= V_NAME;
 ELSE
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.SRCE_COM:= NULL;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_EXT_REQ_ITEM_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DISP_EXT_REQ_ITEM_DATA RETURN BOOLEAN IS
RET BOOLEAN;

BEGIN

SELECT EXT_DECREE_NBR,EXT_DECREE_SUB1,EXT_DECREE_SUB2,EXT_DECREE_DT,
 EXT_DECREE_ITEM_SEQ,EXT_DECREE_ITEM_SUB,
 RQRD_QTY,ACTL_EXMTD_QTY,HRMNZD_CODE,REQ_ITEM_STA_CD,INTL_MSR_UNIT
INTO :EXT_DECREE_NBR,:EXT_DECREE_SUB1,:EXT_DECREE_SUB2,:EXT_DECREE_DT
 ,:EXT_DECREE_ITEM_SEQ,:EXT_DECREE_ITEM_SUB,:RQRD_QTY,:ACTL_EXMTD_QTY
 ,:EXT_REQ_ITEM_TRF_CD,:EXT_REQ_ITEM_STA_CD,:UB_INTL_MSR_UNIT
FROM EXT_REQ_DTLS
WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD = :EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD
AND REQ_ISN = :EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN
AND REQ_ITEM_SEQ = :EXT_EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ;

/*IF :UB_INTL_MSR_UNIT IS NULL THEN

END IF;*/



IF :EXT_REQ_ITEM_TRF_CD <> :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('بند التعرفة لصنف الطلب في خطاب التحويل يختلف عن بند التعرفة المعروض','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;

IF :EXMTD_QTY IS NULL
THEN
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_MSR_UNIT = :UB_INTL_MSR_UNIT THEN
 :GLOBAL.MATCH_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY < :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY
 THEN :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY;
 ELSE :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INV_QTY;
 END IF;
 ELSE
 :GLOBAL.MATCH_UNIT_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
 IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY < :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY
 THEN :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.ACTL_EXMTD_QTY;
 ELSE :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END IF;



RET := TRUE;
RETURN(RET);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد صنف على الطلب بهذا المسلسل');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد صنف على الطلب بهذا المسلسل');
 RET := FALSE;

RETURN(RET);
END;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DISP_EXT_REQ_DATA RETURN BOOLEAN IS
RET BOOLEAN := TRUE;
V_REQ_STAT NUMBER;
V_REQ_IMPR NUMBER;
V_DCLTN_NBR NUMBER;
INT_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN

IF :EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD IS NOT NULL THEN
SELECT EXT_EXMTN_TYPE,REQ_STA_CD,HQ_IMPR_NBR,DCLTN_NBR
INTO :EXT_EXMTN_TYPE,V_REQ_STAT,V_REQ_IMPR,V_DCLTN_NBR
FROM EXT_EXMTN_REQS
WHERE ISSUE_PORT_CD = :EXT_EXMTN_PORT_CD
AND REQ_ISN = :EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN;
ELSE
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO INT_COUNT
 FROM EXT_EXMTN_REQS
WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = :UB_EXT_DECREE_PORT_CD
AND REQ_ISN = :EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN;
IF INT_COUNT <> 1 THEN
 MESSAGE('من فضلك استخدم القائمة');
 MESSAGE('من فضلك استخدم القائمة');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;
SELECT EXT_EXMTN_TYPE,REQ_STA_CD,HQ_IMPR_NBR,DCLTN_NBR
INTO :EXT_EXMTN_TYPE,V_REQ_STAT,V_REQ_IMPR,V_DCLTN_NBR
FROM EXT_EXMTN_REQS
WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = :UB_EXT_DECREE_PORT_CD
AND REQ_ISN = :EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN;
END IF;



/*SELECT EXT_EXMTN_TYPE,REQ_STA_CD,HQ_IMPR_NBR,DCLTN_NBR
INTO :EXT_EXMTN_TYPE,V_REQ_STAT,V_REQ_IMPR,V_DCLTN_NBR
FROM EXT_EXMTN_REQS
WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = :UB_EXT_DECREE_PORT_CD
AND REQ_ISN = :EXT_EXMTN_REQ_ISN;*/



IF V_REQ_IMPR <> :GLOBAL.HQ_IMPR_NBR AND :SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED'
THEN
 RET := FALSE;
 STR.DISPALERT('هذا الطلب لا يخص المستورد على بيان الاستيراد المعروض','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
ELSIF V_DCLTN_NBR <> :DCLTN_HDR.DCLTN_NBR
THEN
 STR.DISPALERT('رقم البيان في خطاب التحويل يختلف عن البيان المعروض','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

-- ADDED BY KAMEL IN 07/07/2007 (V_REQ_STAT NOT IN (4,5))
ELSIF V_REQ_STAT NOT IN(4,5) AND :SYSTEM.BLOCK_STATUS = 'CHANGED' -- معتمد و جاهز لبيان الاستيراد
THEN
 RET := FALSE;
 STR.DISPALERT('حالة الطلب غير جاهز حاليا للاستخدام ببيان استيراد..راجع الاعفاءات','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;

END IF;

RETURN(RET);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد طلب بهذا المسلسل');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد طلب بهذا المسلسل');
 RET := FALSE;

RETURN(RET);
END;

 ;

 EXCEPTION

 END;

 V_COUNT NUMBER;
 V_COUNT_HQ NUMBER;

BEGIN

/* SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ
 ;
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO V_COUNT_HQ
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS_HQ DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ
 ;
*/

IF :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD = 99 THEN
 SELECT ITEM_QTY_BALC,ITEM_TYPE_CD,ITEM_ARBC_DESC,ITEM_STA_CD,EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,HRMNZD_CODE
 INTO :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_QTY_BALC , :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD ,

 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_HRMNZD_CODE
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS_HQ DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD = 99
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD = 99
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ;


ELSIF :GLOBAL.FILLER2 =99 THEN

 SELECT ITEM_QTY_BALC,ITEM_TYPE_CD,ITEM_ARBC_DESC,ITEM_STA_CD,EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,HRMNZD_CODE
 INTO :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_QTY_BALC , :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD ,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ARBC_DESC,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_STA_CD,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_HRMNZD_CODE
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS_HQ DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD = 99
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD = 99
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN = :GLOBAL.FILLER3
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ;
ELSE
 SELECT ITEM_QTY_BALC,ITEM_TYPE_CD,ITEM_ARBC_DESC,ITEM_STA_CD,EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,HRMNZD_CODE
 INTO :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_QTY_BALC , :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_TYPE_CD ,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_ARBC_DESC,:DCLTN_ITEMS.ITEM_STA_CD,
 :DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC,:DCLTN_ITEMS.DI_HRMNZD_CODE
 FROM DECREE_ACPTD_ITEMS DAI
 WHERE DAI.DECREE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DAI.APLCTN_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.PORT_CD
 AND DAI.DECREE_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 AND DAI.ITEM_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ
 AND DAI.ITEM_SUB_SEQ = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ;
END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد بند اعفاء على القرار المعروض بهذا المسلسل');
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد بند اعفاء على القرار المعروض بهذا المسلسل');


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_DECREE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_DECREE_DATA IS
V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD NUMBER;
BEGIN

 SELECT DECREE_NBR,DECREE_SUB1,DECREE_SUB2,DECREE_DT,TOT_EXMTN_AMT,EXMTN_AMT_BALC
 ,EXMTN_MTHD_CD
 INTO :UB_DECREE_NBR,:UB_D_SUB1,:UB_D_SUB2,:UB_DECREE_DT,:UB_EXMTN_AMOUNT,:UB_EXMTN_AMOUNT_BALANCE
 ,V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES
 WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 UNION
 SELECT DECREE_NBR,DECREE_SUB1,DECREE_SUB2,DECREE_DT,TOT_EXMTN_AMT,EXMTN_AMT_BALC
 ,EXMTN_MTHD_CD
 FROM EXMTN_DECREES_HQ
 WHERE DECREE_PORT_CD = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_PORT_CD
 AND DECREE_ISN = :DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_DECREE_ISN
 ;


 :GLOBAL.EXMTN_METHOD := V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD;
 IF V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD IS NOT NULL AND V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD IN (3,4) -- NO DECREE ITEMS ( TOTAL AMOUNT OR OPENED DECREE )
 THEN
 SET_TAB_PAGE_PROPERTY('CG$TAB_PAGE_5', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SEQ',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DCLTN_ITEMS.EXMTN_ITEM_SUB_SEQ',NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 IF V_GOV_DECREE_MTHD = 3
 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UB_EXMTN_AMOUNT',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UB_EXMTN_AMOUNT_BALANCE',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UB_EXMTN_AMOUNT',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UB_EXMTN_AMOUNT_BALANCE',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('DI_EXMTD_CIF_AMT_BALC',VISIBLE,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 MESSAGE('لم يمكن استرجاع بيانات القرار المسجل بصنف البيان');
 MESSAGE('لم يمكن استرجاع بيانات القرار المسجل بصنف البيان');


END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISP_AGRMNT_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE DISP_AGRMNT_DATA IS
V_MAX_QTY NUMBER;
V_RMN_QTY NUMBER;
V_AGR_TYPE NUMBER;
V_GCC_NM VARCHAR2(100);
V_QULFY_NO VARCHAR2(10);
V_QULFY_DATE DATE;
BEGIN
:GLOBAL.INDUSTRY_TYPE := 1; -- Let all work without items
IF :EXMTN_TYPE != 5 OR ( :EXMTN_TYPE = 5 AND :GLOBAL.INDUSTRY_TYPE = 2)
THEN

BEGIN
 SELECT AI.PRCNT_RDCTN,AI.MAX_QTY,AI.RMN_QTY,AGR.AGRMNT_ST_DT,
 AGR.AGRMNT_EN_DT,AM.MEMBER_ISN,AM.AM_TYPE,
 AM.INDSTRY_NAME,AGR.AGRMNT_TYPE,AM.QULFY_NO,AM.QULFY_DATE
 INTO :PRCNT_RDCTN,V_MAX_QTY,V_RMN_QTY,:AGRMNT_ST_DT,:AGRMNT_EN_DT
 ,:AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN,:AM_TYPE,V_GCC_NM,V_AGR_TYPE,V_QULFY_NO,V_QULFY_DATE
 FROM AGRMNT_ITEMS AI,AGRMNT_MEMBERS AM,AGRMNTS AGR
 WHERE AI.AGRMNT_NO = :AGRMNT_NO2
 AND AI.HRMNZD_CODE = :DCLTN_ITEMS.FINAL_TARIFF_CD
 AND AI.MEMBER_ISN = :AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
 AND AM.MEMBER_ISN = AI.MEMBER_ISN
 AND AM.AGRMNT_NO = AI.AGRMNT_NO
 AND AGR.AGRMNT_NO = AI.AGRMNT_NO
 AND ITEM_STATUS <> 1
 AND NVL(EXMTN_ITEM_FLAG,1) = 1;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 BEGIN
 SELECT AM.PRCNT_RDCTN,NULL,NULL,AGR.AGRMNT_ST_DT,
 AGR.AGRMNT_EN_DT,AM.MEMBER_ISN,AM.AM_TYPE,
 AM.INDSTRY_NAME,AGR.AGRMNT_TYPE,AM.QULFY_NO,AM.QULFY_DATE
 INTO :PRCNT_RDCTN,V_MAX_QTY,V_RMN_QTY,:AGRMNT_ST_DT,:AGRMNT_EN_DT
 ,:AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN,:AM_TYPE,V_GCC_NM,V_AGR_TYPE,V_QULFY_NO,V_QULFY_DATE
 FROM AGRMNT_MEMBERS AM,AGRMNTS AGR
 WHERE AM.MEMBER_ISN = :AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
 AND AM.AGRMNT_NO = :AGRMNT_NO2
 AND AGR.AGRMNT_NO = AM.AGRMNT_NO
 AND AM.ALL_ITEM_FLAG IN (1,2);
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;
 END;
END;

 ELSE

:PRCNT_RDCTN := 100;
SELECT AGR.AGRMNT_ST_DT,
 AGR.AGRMNT_EN_DT,AM.MEMBER_ISN,AM.AM_TYPE,
 AM.INDSTRY_NAME,AGR.AGRMNT_TYPE,AM.QULFY_NO,AM.QULFY_DATE
INTO :AGRMNT_ST_DT,:AGRMNT_EN_DT
 ,:AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN,:AM_TYPE,V_GCC_NM,V_AGR_TYPE,V_QULFY_NO,V_QULFY_DATE
FROM AGRMNT_MEMBERS AM,AGRMNTS AGR
WHERE AGR.AGRMNT_NO = :AGRMNT_NO2
AND AM.MEMBER_ISN = :AGRMNT_MEMBER_ISN
AND AM.AGRMNT_NO = :AGRMNT_NO2;

END IF;

IF :EXMTN_RATE IS NULL
THEN
 :EXMTN_RATE := :PRCNT_RDCTN;
ELSE
 :PRCNT_RDCTN := :EXMTN_RATE;
END IF;

IF :EXMTN_TYPE IN(5,10) -- GULF FACTORIES AGREEMENT OR AIRLINES
THEN
 :AM_INDSTRY_NAME := V_GCC_NM;
 :L_AM_QULFY_NO := V_QULFY_NO;
 :L_AM_QULFY_DATE := V_QULFY_DATE;
 --COPY(V_GCC_NM,:AM_INDSTRY_NAME);
 DISP_SRC_COMP_DATA;
END IF;

IF :EXMTN_TYPE = 10 -- AIRLINES, CHECK MAXIMUM,AVAILABLE QTY
THEN
 :AI_MAX_QTY := V_MAX_QTY;
 :AI_RMN_QTY := V_RMN_QTY;
 IF :AI_RMN_QTY < :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY
 THEN :EXMTD_QTY := :AI_RMN_QTY;
 ELSE :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
 END IF;
ELSE -- IF ANY OTHER AGREMENT TYPE RATHER THAN AIRLINES
 :EXMTD_QTY := :DCLTN_ITEMS.INTL_QTY;
END IF;

IF (V_AGR_TYPE = 1 AND :EXMTN_TYPE <> 7) OR (V_AGR_TYPE = 2 AND :EXMTN_TYPE <> 9)
THEN
 MESSAGE('سوف يتم تغيير نوع الاعفاء حسب نوع الاتفاقية');
 MESSAGE('سوف يتم تغيير نوع الاعفاء حسب نوع الاتفاقية');

 IF V_AGR_TYPE = 1 AND :EXMTN_TYPE <> 7
 THEN :EXMTN_TYPE := 7;
 ELSIF V_AGR_TYPE = 2 AND :EXMTN_TYPE <> 9
 THEN :EXMTN_TYPE := 9;
 END IF;

 SELECT TYPE_NAME
 INTO :ET_TYPE_NAME
 FROM EXMTN_TYPES
 WHERE TYPE_CD = :EXMTN_TYPE;


END IF;

 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('EXMTN_TYPE',ITEM_IS_VALID,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('AGRMNT_NO2',ITEM_IS_VALID,PROPERTY_TRUE);

EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN NULL;

END;
